race.description: Emf Group Izzy's Gift Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ENTERPRISING (5) has the right profile to take this Maiden out after running third in a Class 1 over 1600m at Goulburn. Looks to have more upside than most of these and gets map favours. VELASTRA (8) is the clear danger after running second over 1600m at Wyong on soft ground, beaten a length, and she also comes back from provincial company with scope to progress again. BABYFACED ASSASSIN (11) has been racing in Class 1 company over 2000m and 2200m, including a narrow Canberra placing two back. Exposed staying form gives him a strong base despite the drop back in distance. Each way contender. NEAREST (2) third up for this and strips fitter after he warmed up late to run second at Scone over 1400m. Should appreciate the extra ground and has been heavily supported this morning.
